title: Black Collared Dress with Cream Trim
prompt: An original young woman with soft, shoulder-length light brown waves sits on a stone ledge in front of a weathered stone wall. She wears a fitted black short-sleeve knit dress with a cream collar, cream placket, and pearl buttons, with cream trim at the cuffs and hem. A simple gold bracelet sits on one wrist. Her expression is calm and composed, looking toward the camera. Soft natural daylight, a palette of black, cream, and warm stone. Refined and classic, in the style of a timeless street portrait.
workingNotes:
- The cream trim and pearl buttons are the key details.
- Keep the stone wall for a classic architectural backdrop.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the stone wall as the backdrop.
